sources.title: Cross-tokamak disruption prediction based on domain adaptation
sources.checked: Published pp.4-6, feature table, split table, normalization and operational lead definitions; preprint identity checked
sources.boundary: Published target normalization and S-CORAL use EAST data; not a zero-target-information comparator.

sources.title: Balancing physics priors and data for disruption prediction in future tokamaks
sources.checked: Abstract; data table and target-data regimes; section 4.3 pp.11-12
sources.boundary: Weak persistent tearing-mode case is useful mechanistic motivation; target-data training and post-failure classifier fine-tuning do not demonstrate unlabeled intra-shot gains.

sources.title: Scenario adaptive disruption prediction study for next generation burning-plasma tokamaks
sources.boundary: LP/HP operational matching does not validate Ip/Bt as damage labels. Do not quote DOI or exact publication metadata from a draft header.

sources.title: Disruption Precursor Onset Time Study Based on Semi-supervised Anomaly Detection
sources.checked: Primary abstract and operational evaluation section pp.8-9
sources.boundary: Supports examining time labels; does not validate the supplied A-F interval boundaries.

sources.title: Disruption Event Characterization and Forecasting in Tokamaks
sources.boundary: Do not merge this repository record automatically with the 2023 same-title DOI in the older index; no detailed model reproduction claim.

sources.title: Integrated deep learning framework for unstable event identification and disruption prediction of tokamak plasmas
sources.checked: Primary institutional PDF search extract only; full retrieval failed (502; local TLS trust failure)
sources.boundary: Existence and general event/prediction integration only. No claimed full-text reading or unverified sample-count/performance reproduction.

sources.title: An application of survival analysis to disruption prediction via Random Forests
sources.checked: Abstract and sections 5.3, 6, 7 (false alarm, summary and limitations)
sources.boundary: A small number of illustrative cases; not evidence of neural intra-shot learning or general superiority.

sources.title: MT3: Meta Test-Time Training for Self-Supervised Test-Time Adaption
sources.checked: Primary PDF pp.1-4, method and adaptation/reset semantics
sources.boundary: Image adaptation; meta-learning itself is not a new project contribution, nor evidence of EAST performance.

sources.title: Learning to Select the Best Forecasting Tasks for Clinical Outcome Prediction
sources.checked: Abstract and section 3.1, Figure 1, task-weight formulation; section 4.3 excerpts
sources.boundary: Clinical outcome representation pretraining, not tokamak adaptation; use as task-selection rationale only.

sources.title: Battling the Non-stationarity in Time Series Forecasting via Test-time Adaptation
sources.checked: Challenges and opportunities; PAAS/GCM; partly observed target timing
sources.boundary: Forecasting-error objective and input/output calibration; cannot be equated to disruption-risk adaptation. Do not rewrite sealed predictions.

sources.title: Test-Time Training with Masked Autoencoders
sources.checked: Section 3, encoder/decoder update and probe versus joint-training design; checked in preceding experiment review
sources.boundary: The existing source training and timeseries task are not a reproduction of MAE image adaptation.

sources.title: On Pitfalls of Test-Time Adaptation
sources.boundary: Supports model-quality and evaluation concerns; no imported quantitative EAST bound.

sources.title: TimeDRL: Disentangled Representation Learning for Multivariate Time-Series
sources.boundary: Timestamp/instance representation split is not proof of physical nuisance/danger disentanglement. Its instance normalization must not silently replace physical levels.

sources.title: TimeMAE: Self-Supervised Representations of Time Series with Decoupled Masked Autoencoders
sources.checked: Version-4 primary abstract and revision/publication metadata
sources.boundary: 2023 preprint, revised 2026 with WSDM26 acceptance stated. Do not cite it as an ICML2023 paper or as a causal-online guarantee.

sources.title: Training on the Future: A Delay-Aware Audit of Test-Time Adaptation for Time-Series Forecasting
sources.checked: Primary preprint abstract and section 3 including partial-window and full-window release
sources.boundary: Recent preprint; no independent reproduction. Borrow timing audit question, not its benchmark effect sizes or output-corrector architecture.

sources.title: On the Learnability of Test-Time Adaptation: A Recovery Complexity Perspective
sources.boundary: No use of theorem guarantees before checking their assumptions against this data.
